source: The `lts` field of every release in https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json: the codename of the line, and the major number of the first release that carries it.
note: A major number in this table is a long-term-support line. `lts/*` and the default Node mean the highest of them that is installed or can be installed; a new LTS line is one more entry here, with no code change. A table that is out of date makes `lts/*` pick an older LTS line, never a line that is not LTS.
